title: quetzalia ilicina
intro: Quetzalia ilicina, commonly known as Mexican Cedar, is a plant species belonging to the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. The health benefits of Quetzalia ilicina include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help alleviate pain, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include limonoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as analgesia, anti-inflammatory responses, and modulation of the immune system.
